title: OpenBar M0 manual target seed
description: Standalone serialized wrapper for the Rust manual target seed domain type.

fixture_id.description: Optional fixture identifier from the M0 fixture manifest.

timestamp_s.description: Authoritative reference time in seconds on the decoded media timeline.

frame_index.description: Optional auxiliary frame lookup; timestamp remains authoritative.

coordinate_space.description: Display-oriented pixels after applying source rotation; origin top-left, +X right, +Y down.

source_rotation_deg.description: Source rotation metadata that was applied before the display-oriented seed coordinates were selected.

selection_confidence.description: Optional human/annotation confidence in the manual selection, never tracker confidence.

radius_px.description: Canonical seed geometry. Diameter and square bounds are derived explicitly from this radius.
